answer: Stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a deposit proportional to the reputation it claims, and the ledger slashes any cluster of accounts that votes in lockstep. One honest node needs a single small opal's worth of stake; a walnut-sized fake farm must lock hundreds of them, and the grove of genuine agents that outvotes it keeps the slashed funds. Attackers pay real capital per fake identity and lose it the moment their cluster is detected, so sybils cost more than the work they fake.
